entry_item.definition: [bidygyn] adj. Large, huge, big; crude, clumsy; plain, simple; ignorant, rough; deep (of voice).

example.definition: Simple or crude person; a big man.
oierre grossière qu'on ne saurait polir
le boyau gros, le gros intestin
